approval_boundaries: cli:s0ma/feedback: Nothing leaves your machine until you have read the report back and said yes. Decline and the draft stays where it is.
topic.intent: Take somebody who has never written a s0ma project from an empty folder to a first check they can trust.
recovery_paths: a declaration that does not hold together -> cli:s0ma/check: Read the first finding rather than the last; the ones below it are often the same mistake seen again.
step_outcomes: A project skeleton, and a note saying what was written where.
Either a clean report, or a list of what does not hold and where to look.
The report you wrote, sent once, and a note of where it went.
step_purposes: Get a folder that is already a project rather than one you have to make into one.
Find out whether what you have written holds together before you build anything on it.
Say what got in your way while it is still fresh, in your own words.
